thread:
olivia: quick heads-up from today's staging soak. observed metadata races where claim writes arrived out-of-order to the meta-log due to leader-stepdown; resulted in ephemeral duplicate ACTIVE markers. not customer-facing but breaks our handoff invariants.

olivia: snippet:
```\n2026-03-22T02:12:00Z LEADER_STEPDOWN node=meta-2
2026-03-22T02:12:01Z CLAIM node=node-9 prefix=/sessions/ era=205 token=node-9|205
2026-03-22T02:12:01Z CLAIM node=node-4 prefix=/sessions/ era=206 token=node-4|206
2026-03-22T02:12:02Z META_LOG_APPLY node=meta-3 op=claim node=9 era=205
2026-03-22T02:12:03Z META_LOG_APPLY node=meta-3 op=claim node=4 era=206
2026-03-22T02:12:04Z ACTIVE node=node-9 prefix=/sessions/ era=205
2026-03-22T02:12:05Z ACTIVE node=node-4 prefix=/sessions/ era=206
```

sam: leader re-election can cause commits to be applied in different order across replicas if we don't enforce linearizable apply. our meta-log is only eventually consistent across meta nodes right now.

kevin: if we strengthen meta-log to linearizable CAS for claims, we can prevent that; but that's a bigger change. short-term idea: attach monotonically increasing commit-seq to meta-log entries and require runtime to only transition to ACTIVE when it reads its own commit-seq as the highest seen. that defers activation until meta-log tail is stable.

ira: that sounds reasonable. sequence flow: Claim() writes meta with promise -> meta-log assigns commit_seq -> client polls meta-log until its claim commit_seq is the latest for that prefix -> then it flips to ACTIVE. ensures activation order.

olivia: downside: time-to-active increases by round-trip to meta-log being durable across quorum. maybe 10s of ms. But avoids split ACTIVE markers.

sam: also need to handle the case where client never sees its commit_seq as latest due to being truly preempted. it should abort and backoff after timeout. add metric `claim_stalled_until_seq` and `claim_activation_latency_ms`.

kevin: open question: should demote/evict also use commit_seq gating? likely yes for symmetric behavior.

ira: let's prototype commit_seq gating on activation only (not demote) and measure. if works, extend to demote.

meta-bot: ticket INF-4410 created for commit_seq gating experiment, assigned to kevin and olivia.

olivia: action items:
- kevin -> implement commit_seq in meta-log and expose on Claim() response (PR by 3/26)
- olivia -> runtime activation gating logic + metrics (PR by 3/28)
- sam -> add e2e test that simulates leader stepdown and ensures only one ACTIVE becomes visible (start 3/29)

ira: good. add debug trace `meta_commit_seq` to claims so we can trace this in production when needed. keep default logging minimal.

olivia: ok closing this thread, will follow-up with PR links. thanks.
